evals.prompt: Import /Users/me/recordings/leadership-course into my Obsidian vault at /Users/me/vault under sources/leadership. The folder contains MP4 lectures, MP3 audio, PDFs, and PPTX handouts.
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects the source, resolves policies, runs and presents a dry-run, waits for confirmation, imports through media-import, validates the corpus, and reports manifest status.
assertions: Runs inspect and dry-run before any write
Uses one Markdown artifact per media source with chronological visual text

evals.prompt: Archive https://example.com/talk.mp4 as searchable Markdown in ~/vault/sources/talk. This Mac is Apple Silicon and I want local processing only.
evals.expected_output: The agent selects Docling media conversion, keeps remote services disabled, uses the auto MLX Whisper Turbo route on Apple Silicon, and follows the dry-run confirmation gate.
assertions: Uses Docling as the media engine
Uses external processing by default without requiring a CLI approval flag
Uses the Apple Silicon MLX auto route
Does not expose timestamps in generated Markdown

evals.prompt: Resume the media import in ~/vault/sources/conference after I edited one generated transcript by hand and replaced one source video.
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects current state, protects the manually modified transcript, identifies the changed source, presents a dry-run, and resumes only after confirmation.
assertions: Does not overwrite the manually modified artifact

evals.prompt: Import the books in /Users/me/books into /Users/me/vault under sources/books. There are three EPUB files and I want to decide separately whether each book's images should be referenced, skipped, or OCRed.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs inventory first, then asks for an explicit image-processing choice for each detected book before presenting the dry-run. It does not silently apply referenced to every book and reports the selected policies in the dry-run and final manifest.
assertions: Runs inspect as inventory before asking ebook image questions
Asks for a separate referenced, skip, or ocr choice for every book
Does not silently apply the package default referenced
Runs dry-run only after all per-book choices are resolved
Reports selected ebook image policies in dry-run and final manifest
